attempted_claim: Let p be an odd prime and A subset of F_p^* with |A| << p^{1/2}. Does there exist A' subset of A with |A'| >= |A|/2 such that min{E^+(A'), E^x(A')} <= C (log|A|)^K |A|^{11/4}, where E^+ and E^x are the additive and multiplicative energies? Equivalently, does every such A admit a partition A = B disjoint-union C with max{E^+(B), E^x(C)} <= C (log|A|)^K |A|^{11/4}?
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of the energy-energy 11/4 bound was obtained; all routes stalled at quantified barriers (BSG exponent 47/16, incidence exponent near 14/5). The bounded computation covers only tiny primes (p=11, 13) and cannot probe asymptotic behavior; the subset-vs-partition remark is an elementary observation, not a substitute result. No independently valuable emergent finding was produced.
